subject.title: Improve read tool handling for binary document formats (.docx, .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx) & Avoid Token Waste on Binary Read

question: Should the read tool get a narrow binary-document fallback now, or should this issue wait for broader document extraction/provider-native file work?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the safe fallback, parser-backed extraction, and provider-native file designs have different core, security, and plugin-boundary tradeoffs that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Land Narrow Fallback
options.body: Review, repair, or replace the linked guard work so known PDF/Office document reads return a clear unsupported-document message instead of decoded bytes.

options.title: Fold Into Document Work
options.body: Keep this open as context for shared document extraction or provider-native file support and close or supersede the narrow guard candidate.

options.title: Defer Core Parsing
options.body: Keep `read` text/image-only and route parser-heavy document handling to plugins or ClawHub unless a missing core API is identified.

recommendation.title: Land Narrow Fallback
recommendation.body: Review, repair, or replace the linked guard work so known PDF/Office document reads return a clear unsupported-document message instead of decoded bytes.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current routing signal for deciding the core read/document boundary from recent area history and prior review context.
